task: Build and run a package of the blaze edition (`edition = "blaze-2026.11"`) from a checkout
do: `blaze new --vcs none --bstd <checkout>/crates/blaze-std hello`, copy the checkout's Cargo.lock to hello/Cargo.lock (bstd's dependencies at the tree's versions), `blaze run` in it. The end-to-end tests are `the_blaze_edition_*` and `blaze_new_then_run_*` in crates/blaze-engine/tests/repro.rs.
why: A package of the edition names bstd by path until blaze ships it (docs/v2/plan/design/std.md, row S5d).
